messages.content:
We must keep track of the chats that are being updated with new messages. When a new chat message is coming and is not "done" we must update a collection of (kind of "chatEvents") and set the chat (by id) event "updating" to true and false when message is done.
It should be reactive so other vue components can detect that a chat (by id) is beign updated
For "SET_CHAT_UPDATING" use camelCase for methods and invoke them using $storex.chats.methodToCall
the "done" state of a message can be miss so instead of a "true" flag use a timestemp and the isUpdating will be true if chat updating timestamp is less that 3 secs ago
The timestamp idea is not working, so probably we need some other way to reset the "updating" flag, any idea?
The "done" event can be skipped or miss from server so we must reset the updting after, let's say, 3 secs of no updates, that's why we were using the timestamp

Ok, so time to check the updating flag system, this message will trigger server work and I'm expecting the UI to react and falg been reset when done or 3 secs (maybe we can increase to 10 as we can work with slow models)

:( the reset is not working but we know that the chat changes are done because there's chat events and all messages are "done" (check message.done)
So on chat events see if all their messages are "done" and reset the updating flag
ok, time to test the chat updating status, generate 3 lines of random text, no changes

The purple elephant danced gracefully on the moonlit rooftop while eating crackers.
